paper_title: First Results from the Taiwan Axion Search Experiment with Haloscope at 19.6 $μ$eV
coupling_convention: |g_agamma| in units of 10^-14 GeV^-1 (values emitted as absolute GeV^-1)
notes: Haloscope search for axions in 19.4687-19.8436 ueV (4.70750-4.79815 GHz). Limits on |g_agamma| range 5.3e-14 to 8.9e-14 GeV^-1, average 8.2e-14. Text gives range but not per-frequency values; data points approximate the boundaries/average.
